title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**What you'll bring:**

**Required**

* 3–7+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or AI Engineer (flexible based on seniority).
* Proven experience building AI agents or LLM-driven applications in production contexts.
* Hands-on work with libraries/frameworks such as LangChain, OpenAI/MCP, LlamaIndex, or similar orchestration tools.
* Proficiency with Python (or Typescript/Node) and modern development workflows.
* Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, vector databases, and retrieval systems.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, containerization (Docker), cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure), and DevOps fundamentals.
* Familiarity with automated testing approaches for LLM applications (unit tests, scenario testing, eval harnesses).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to design resilient systems in ambiguous environments.

**Preferred**

* Experience deploying and scaling MCP servers, custom toolchains, or enterprise agent frameworks.
* Prior work building tools or automations for Sales, Marketing, or RevOps teams (e.g., CRM-integrated apps, quoting tools, outbound tooling, marketing analytics or experimentation platforms).
* Background or project experience in the building industry (construction, materials distribution, building automation, supply chain, procurement) or other B2B industry.
* Experience with workflow engines (Airflow, Prefect, etc) and/or MLOps (Mlflow, Flyte, etc) and event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with vector and search/retrieval systems.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, or RLHF-style evaluation frameworks.

  
  

**What you'll do:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer, AI to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI agents that augment workflows across our organization. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with agentic frameworks, MCP servers, LLM orchestration libraries, and robust testing/monitoring practices. This role blends software engineering excellence with applied machine learning and offers the opportunity to push the boundaries of intelligent automation in real business environments.

**Responsibilities**

**AI Agent Development & Deployment**

* Architect, build, and optimize AI agents using modern agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalents).
* Implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom tools, and integrations to enable secure and scalable agent capabilities.
* Design agentic workflows that can operate autonomously, perform multi-step reasoning, and interact with structured/unstructured data sources.
* Package and deploy agents into production environments with attention to reliability, observability, and performance.

**Sales & Marketing Agent Use Cases**

* Build agents that support Sales Representatives, such as:
* Lead and account research, enrichment, and prioritization.
* Drafting and personalizing outbound emails and sequences.
* Summarizing calls, meetings, and account activity to drive next-best actions.
* Integrating with CRM and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach) to automate data entry and insight surfacing.
* Generating detailed bills of materials (BOMs), estimates, and quotes from drawings, specs, takeoffs, or CRM/opportunity data, including price checks, margin validation, and versioning.
* Build agents that support Marketing, such as:
* Generating and localizing content for campaigns, landing pages, and nurture programs.
* Assisting with audience segmentation, experimentation, and performance analysis.
* Powering internal “marketing copilots” that answer questions from campaign, web, and analytics data.
* Partner with the business to identify high-ROI workflows for automation and to measure the impact of deployed agents on pipeline, conversion, quoting speed/accuracy, and engagement metrics.

**Systems Engineering & Tooling**

* Develop internal libraries, reusable modules, and standardized patterns for building agentic applications.
* Integrate agent systems with enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, pricing/catalog systems, and operational infrastructure.
* Build CI/CD pipelines for both model-related code and agent-specific behavior, including automated testing, evaluation harnesses, and regression detection for LLM-powered systems.

**Testing, Evaluation & Monitoring**

* Create frameworks for continuous evaluation of agents, including prompt tests, scenario simulations, and safety/robustness checks.
* Monitor agent performance in production, diagnose failures, and iterate quickly on improvements.
* Implement logging, analytics, and feedback loops to guide ongoing training or refinement—especially for critical revenue and quoting workflows.

**Collaboration & Strategy**

* Work closely with product, engineering, Sales, Marketing, and domain experts to translate business processes into agentic flows.
* Partner with stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and design AI-powered operational solutions.
* Contribute to internal documentation, best practices, and AI engineering guidelines.

description:
Overview:

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

**Position Summary**:

We're hiring an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer I to help build and maintain our metric intelligence platform: the agents, skills, and backend services that turn governed business metrics into automated analysis for teams across the company.

This position is part of the Enterprise Data Services Division-we own the company's metric definitions, the semantic layer that serves them, and an AI-powered analytics platform built on top. Metric logic lives in version-controlled code; agents and applications read from it rather than reinventing it.

This is an engineering role, not a prompt-writing role. Most of the platform's skills are deterministic Python, with AI agents orchestrating them. You'll spend more time making things correct, tested, and reliable than making them clever.

  
Geo-Salary Information:

***An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process***

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$83,670.00 to $161,815.00 (NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$76,064 to $147,104 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$68,457 to $132,394 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

In CA: Typical hiring range is $98,194 - $153,428

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Agents and skills management**

* Build, test, and maintain the Python skills and AI agents that run on the platform.
* Keep a clean skills catalog: versioning, documentation, ownership, and retiring skills that are no longer used.
* Build evaluation and regression checks (test sets, validators, output-format rules) so agent quality is consistent from run to run.
* Monitor agent usage, cost, and failures, and fix the root cause rather than the symptom.

**Platform backend maintenance**

* Maintain the platform's agent runtime, built on a TypeScript agent framework (Mastra): agent workflows, tool definitions, memory, and model configuration.
* Maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that link agents to the warehouse, semantic layer, BI tools, and other company systems.
* Keep the platform's API services, scheduled jobs, and data pipelines healthy; handle framework, SDK, and model version upgrades.
* Triage and resolve failed jobs, broken connectors, data-quality alerts, and user-reported issues.
* Improve CI/CD, logging, and monitoring so problems surface before users find them.
* Write runbooks so any teammate can operate the platform.

**Data foundation (working knowledge)**

* Understand how the gold data layer and semantic models feed the platform, and make small, reviewed changes to them.
* Work with the metric tree, the map of how business metrics drive each other, to connect new metrics and their relationships to the platform.
* Trace a number from the platform back to its source data when something looks wrong.

  
Qualifications:

**Education:**

**Minimum**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant quantitative, technical, engineering, or business-related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Preferred**

* Masters Degree in a quantitative field
* CS, engineering, math, or stats degree preferred

**Experience:**

**Minimum**

* Typically requires 2 years of relevant experience in AI native analytics

**Preferred**

* Experience with native AI implementations in Insurance industry

**Knowledge and Skills:**

**Programming**

* Python: writes, tests, and debugs modular code independently. Deterministic Python
* TypeScript/JavaScript: can read and change an existing backend codebase. Mastra is TS-based, so this is required.
* SQL: joins, aggregations, and window functions against a warehouse; can sanity-check a metric's output.

**LLM and agent fundamentals**

* Has built at least one working LLM application end to end, such as a tool-calling agent, a RAG app, or an MCP server. A shipped side project counts.
* Understands prompts versus tools versus retrieval, context limits, and why agent output is nondeterministic.
* Has an instinct for evaluation: tests agent output against expected answers instead of eyeballing it.

**Engineering hygiene**

* Daily use of Git and GitHub: branches, PRs, code review
* Works with REST or JSON APIs and reads API documentation without direct supervision

**Data and domain basics (concepts only)**

* Understands what a semantic layer, dimension, and metric are, and how they differ from raw tables
* Can read a dbt model and YAML config and follow the lineage

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Trailhead Biosystems merges developmental biology with computerized experimental design to develop novel iPSC research products. Trailhead Biosystems is the pioneer of High-Dimensional Design-of-Experiment (HD-DoE®), a powerful platform that differentiates human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) into virtually any desired cell type with unparalleled precision and efficiency. We are moving beyond traditional trial-and-error methods by implementing Quality by Design (QbD) principles and utilizing DoE combined with Multivariate Data Analysis (MVDA).

We are seeking a forward-thinking AI Engineer to join our R&D team and help build the intelligent systems that drive our cellular engineering workflows.

**Why Join Us?** As an AI Engineer at Trailhead, you will not just be managing data; you will be part of a team that is revolutionizing how we explore cell biology, using intelligent systems to direct human iPSC differentiation with unprecedented reproducibility and accuracy

* Generate Computer-Based Experimental Designs: Drive advanced cell culture workflows through AI-supported design, drastically reducing the time and number of experiments needed for optimization.
* Model Biological Complexity: Mathematically model the effector/response space to perform virtual experiments, allowing us to predict how specific additives will create desirable cell culture fates before physical testing.
* Decipher Gene Expression: Gain deep knowledge into how culture conditions affect gene expression, addressing complex optimization challenges regarding cell purity and potency.
* Master Manufacturing Variance: Use data-driven insights to understand and control variance in cell manufacturing methods, ensuring consistent, high-quality outcomes.

**The Role**

As an AI Engineer, you will be instrumental in deploying Agentic AI frameworks that can reason, plan, and execute complex scientific tasks. You will build autonomous multi-agent systems capable of analyzing proprietary biological data, managing knowledge graphs, and optimizing experiments. Working within a robust Azure cloud architecture, you will turn research concepts into production-grade tools that empower our scientists to work faster and smarter.

**Responsibilities**

* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with research scientists, biologists, and product managers to translate complex scientific challenges into actionable technical requirements and scalable AI solutions.
* Develop Agentic AI Solutions: Design and build autonomous AI agents that leverage our proprietary biological datasets to automate complex analytical workflows, from experimental design to data interpretation.
* Fine-Tune Domain-Specific Models: Fine-tune open-weights models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) on our proprietary biological datasets to create specialized models capable of understanding cell differentiation pathways and effector-response relationships.
* Proprietary Data Architecture & UI: Architect, build and maintain a secure proprietary database and automated data ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT), while developing intuitive user-friendly interfaces and APIs that help scientists to easily query, visualize, and interact with our proprietary data.
* Build & Maintain Knowledge Graphs: Integrate GenAI models with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) to map complex relationships between cell lines, reagents, and genetic markers, enabling the AI to perform deep reasoning over structured biological data.
* Orchestrate Multi-Agent Systems: Design and implement sophisticated multi-model, multi-agent architectures using state-of-the-art frameworks such as  LangChain, LangGraph, or  CrewAI. Your systems will coordinate multiple specialized agents to solve multi-step problems collaboratively.
* Production Deployment on Azure: Lead the deployment of AI solutions into a secure  Azure cloud environment. You will be responsible for setting up monitoring, ensuring observability (logging, tracing), and managing the lifecycle of models using MLOps best practices (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, MLflow).
* RAG & Information Retrieval: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in our internal scientific corpus, ensuring high accuracy and reduced hallucinations in technical outputs.
* Evaluation & Benchmarking: Design, implement, and own automated LLM evaluation frameworks and benchmarking suites to quantify model accuracy, reliability, and business impact.
* Guardrails & Quality Assurance & Policy Making: Establish and maintain robust guardrails, observability, and quality gates to mitigate hallucinations, ensure AI safety, and prevent jailbreaking. Help build policies, governance, and procedures.
* Documentation: Create and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks to ensure system reproducibility and facilitate team knowledge sharing.
* Ownership: Own end-to-end model performance and reliability across different systems, including continuous monitoring, logging, and regression testing.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

Education:

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computational Biology or a related quantitative field.

Experience:

* 3-5 years of professional experience in software engineering with a dedicated focus on AI/ML.
* 2+ years of experience developing agentic AI systems and RAG pipelines using large language models, bringing prototypes through to scalable production.

Technical Skills:

* Agentic Frameworks: Strong proficiency with orchestration frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, or  AutoGen. Experience building agents that utilize tool calling and function execution is essential.
* Programming: Expert-level fluency in Python and familiarity with modern software development practices (CI/CD, Git, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes).
* Cloud Architecture: Demonstrated experience deploying scalable applications on Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, and Azure Functions is highly preferred.
* Data Engineering & Knowledge Graphs: Experience designing schemas and querying graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, RDF/SPARQL) and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* MLOps: Practical knowledge of model monitoring, evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, LangSmith), and deploying models via REST APIs (FastAPI).

Soft Skills:

* Ability to translate complex technical concepts for cross-functional teams, including biologists and lab scientists.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a "builder" mindset, you enjoy taking projects from prototype to production.
* Collaborative spirit with a desire to work in a fast-paced, research-driven environment.

Nice to Have:

* Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sectors.
* Familiarity with biological data standards or bioinformatics workflows.

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

title: AI Engineer
description:
We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI models behind our diagnostic platform. You'll work on modern, large-scale machine learning for health, turning large, messy, real-world datasets into models that carry real clinical signal.

You'll join a team of AI engineers who care about doing this the right way. We're looking for someone who brings current knowledge of the field, whether from graduate research or hands-on work, and who pushes the team to approach problems from a modern AI perspective. We want someone who understands why methods work, not someone who can only run a tutorial notebook on an off-the-shelf model. Together you'll assemble and curate large datasets, train and evaluate models, and show whether they carry real clinical signal.

Learning goes both ways here. You'll work alongside experienced AI engineers who review your code and talk through your results, and we expect you to teach them what's new. The work is hands-on from week one. Over time you'll own larger pieces of the pipeline, from data to deployed model.

### **Responsibilities**

* Train and evaluate modern deep learning models on large datasets, including self-supervised approaches and fine-tuning of large pretrained models.
* Build and maintain the data pipelines that feed them: collecting, cleaning, deduplicating, and versioning large video datasets.
* Develop ways to learn from noisy or limited labels, and measure how much real signal the models carry.
* Run experiments carefully: track runs, make results reproducible, and write up what you found, including negative results.
* Design evaluations that reflect real-world use, and show clearly where offline metrics and product performance diverge.
* Support our existing computer vision work as models move toward production.
* Write clean, tested, well-documented Python that teammates can pick up and reuse.
* Take part in code review and technical discussions, and explain your results to both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Stay on top of current AI research. Reproduce promising methods, propose experiments, and teach the team what you learn.
* Pitch in on whatever the team needs. We're small, and everyone does a bit of everything.

### **About Senseye**

Senseye is a NeuroTechnology company based in Austin, TX, on the cusp of revolutionizing mental health. We're developing the world's first objective mental health diagnostics platform, measuring cognitive activity through the eye using mobile devices. Our initial diagnostic for PTSD is entering clinical trials, with additional indications for anxiety and depression to follow. We're a team of scientists, engineers, and clinicians building technology that could redefine how mental health is understood and treated.

 **Requirements**  

* Master's degree or PhD in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience showing comparable machine learning skills, such as several years of applied ML work or substantial published or open-source work.
* Recent graduates are welcome. Up to about 3 years of hands-on ML experience, including graduate research, a thesis, internships, and industry work, is a plus.
* Solid Python and experience with at least one deep learning framework.
* A working grasp of ML fundamentals: training and validation, overfitting, evaluation metrics, and why a good test score isn't the same as a working product.
* Hands-on experience with modern deep learning beyond off-the-shelf use. You've trained or substantially adapted models yourself and can explain your design choices and the tradeoffs.
* Comfort with Git, the command line, and working on a shared codebase.
* Clear writing and communication. You can explain a result or a plot simply and say what you're unsure of.
* Curiosity and the habit of digging in when something looks off, in the data or in your own code.

### **Extra Points**

None of these are required.

* Hands-on experience with self-supervised, contrastive, or masked-modeling methods.
* Experience with large-scale training: multi-GPU runs or experiment tracking such as Weights & Biases.
* Experience with video, time-series, or sensor data.
* Experience with noisy-label learning or semi-supervised methods.
* A paper, open-source contribution, or substantial personal project you can show us.
* Exposure to healthcare, medical device software, or other regulated settings.

  
**Benefits**  

* Flexible schedule and flexible paid time off
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Short- and long-term disability and life insurance
* 401(k)
* Continuing education opportunities
* Health and Wellness stipend
* Fully stocked kitchen and a flexible hybrid environment
* The freedom and trust to shape your role as we design, build, and ship our products

**Machine Learning Engineers** at IMC play a pivotal role in building the systems that drive training and deployment of large-scale ML models across IMC's global operations. They collaborate with quantitative researchers, hardware specialists and software engineers to build robust systems that get the most out of GPU acceleration, distributed computing and the broader open-source ML ecosystem. ML Engineers' work directly shapes how fast we can experiment, iterate and deploy — accelerating the cycle that turns a research idea into a live trading strategy.

This is a unique opportunity to solve problems at the intersection of advanced machine learning and trading, where your contributions will shape the future of IMC's technology and trading capabilities.

As a team, our Machine Learning Engineers broadly work across two areas: **ML Research Engineering**, focused on the systems and frameworks researchers use to train, evaluate and iterate on models at scale; and **ML Performance Engineering**, focused on making ML workloads execute as efficiently as possible, typically through GPU and low-level systems optimization. These aren't rigid tracks, and there is overlap between them. You will bring depth of expertise in at least one of these focus areas and collaborate closely with global team members.

**Your Core Responsibilities**

*The responsibilities below are representative of the role — the exact mix depends on your team, area of expertise and location.*

**ML Research Engineering**

* Develop large-scale distributed training pipelines that manage complex datasets and models.
* Partner with quantitative researchers to automate ML experiments, hyperparameter tuning and model retraining.
* Work with HPC specialists to optimise workflows, improve training speed and reduce compute cost.

**ML Performance Engineering**

* Build and optimise low-latency inference pipelines, ensuring models deliver real-time predictions in production systems.
* Maximise performance in training and inference using GPU hardware and acceleration libraries.

**Across both areas**

* Extend and improve the internals of machine learning frameworks and open-source tools to raise their performance for our workloads.
* Design scalable model infrastructure capable of handling high-volume trading data and delivering real-time, high-accuracy predictions.
* Evaluate and roll out third-party tools that enhance model development, training and inference capabilities.

**Your Skills and Experience**

**Core, regardless of focus area:**

* 3+ years of experience in machine learning, with a focus on training or inference systems.
* **Production software engineering —** Python, testing discipline and genuine ownership of systems once they ship.
* **Machine learning fundamentals —** you understand modern ML workloads beyond high-level APIs and can reason about model behaviour, correctness and performance at the level relevant to your area of expertise.
* **A systems mindset —** you reach for measurement before opinion on performance, scale or reliability issues, and can make sound build-versus-buy decisions.
* **Strong collaboration —** comfortable explaining the reasoning behind your technical decisions, working through differing perspectives with researchers and adapting your approach when the evidence supports it.

**Depth in one or more of the following:**

* **Distributed training and large-scale systems —** parallelism strategy, data pipelines and checkpointing; frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX.
* **GPU performance and low-level optimisation —** reasoning about memory, compute and latency at the device level, and optimising performance across kernels, compilers and hardware (e.g. CUDA, Triton or equivalent).
* **Production inference systems —** hands-on experience building and hardening real-time, low-latency prediction pipelines in high-performance environments.
* **Numerics and correctness at scale —** low-precision effects, KV caching, batching, and knowing which optimisations stay bit-exact.

*Technologies listed above are examples rather than requirements; equivalent depth developed using other stacks or hardware platforms is equally relevant.*

**Also a plus:**

* Exposure to cloud platforms and orchestration tools.
* A track record of contributing to open-source projects in machine learning, data science or distributed systems.

**Not sure this is the one?** If your strength is mainly in modelling and research direction, our Deep Learning Researcher roles are likely a closer fit. If your strength is in general infrastructure rather than ML-specific systems, take a look at our broader infrastructure engineering roles.

title: AI Engineer
description:
As an AI Engineer, you're responsible for designing, building, and shipping AI systems that real people use, from AI features inside products used on over 30 million websites to internal tools built on our behavioral and operational data. You will turn messy real-world data and a user's goals into output people can trust and act on: generated campaigns and content, plain-English recommendations, and automations that save hours of work. We hire for caliber first, then match you to the team where you will have the most impact.

***Interested in applying?***

***Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.***

***Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)***

**To love this role, here's the type of person you are:**

* You're a builder at heart. You don't just use AI tools, you understand how they work under the hood, and you think about how to make them useful for real people, not just technically impressive.
* You care more about how good the output is than which model produced it, and you get restless when an AI feature is just fine.
* You're a self-starter who can take a loosely defined problem, figure out the right approach, and ship a working solution without needing to be told what to do next.
* You think about the user and the decision first, not the pipeline and the model. When you see data, your first instinct is to ask what question it answers for the person who needs it.
* You're comfortable owning the full stack of an AI project, from data exploration and model selection to the API, the interface, and deployment, and making sure it actually works in production.
* You build with AI every day, and you still verify everything before it ships. "The AI did it" is never your answer.
* You're an excellent communicator, fluent in both verbal and written English. You can explain complex technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down.
* You take pride in the quality and craftsmanship of your work: clean code, proper error handling, thoughtful architecture, not just something that works on the happy path.
* You have the curiosity and desire to learn and grow. The AI landscape moves fast and you keep up because you genuinely enjoy it, and you share what you learn so the people around you get faster too.
* You're a team player who is comfortable working alongside developers, product, design, and marketing, and doesn't take critical feedback personally.

**Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):**

* Designing and shipping AI features that turn a user's goal, website, or data into campaigns, content, and recommendations they can act on.
* Building AI-powered internal tools and data-driven systems used across the organization: analytics platforms, reporting automation, and workflow intelligence.
* Designing and building LLM pipelines with solid prompt design, structured and validated output, RAG, guardrails, and agentic workflows.
* Cleaning and analyzing messy product and behavioral data, and grounding AI output in the facts so it never makes numbers up.
* Building data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve behavioral and operational data at scale.
* Setting up evaluation and observability so every iteration is measurably better than the last, and failures are caught before users see them.
* Owning the full path from model output to what the user sees, across backend and frontend.
* Evaluating and selecting the right models, frameworks, and infrastructure for each use case, balancing quality, cost, and latency.
* Watching how people actually use what you build, and turning that into the next improvement.
* Writing clean, well-tested, production-grade code with proper error handling, logging, and observability.
* Documenting your work, including how you used AI to build it, so others can learn from it and reuse it.
* Keeping up with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches to the team.
* Communicating with the team and supporting your peers using chat, audio, and video.

  
**Requirements**  

* 3+ years of professional experience building AI/ML systems in production, with AI features that real users touch (not just POCs or hackathon projects).
* Strong proficiency in Python, including production-grade practices: proper packaging, testing, type hints, and async where appropriate.
* Full-stack experience. You can lean backend or frontend, but you work on both: Python or Node services and a modern frontend such as React.
* Hands-on LLM engineering: prompt design, structured output, tool calling, RAG, guardrails, and evaluation of output quality.
* Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar. You should be able to build a RAG pipeline from scratch.
* Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Qdrant, or similar) and embedding models.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, not just API calls: how models work, when to fine-tune versus prompt engineer, and how to evaluate properly.
* Experience with data processing at scale (SQL, pandas, Spark, or similar), and comfort cleaning messy real-world data.
* Experience building and deploying APIs (FastAPI, Flask, or similar) that serve AI features in production.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with a workflow you can explain.
* Competent with version control through Git and GitHub: clean commit history, proper branching, and code review through PRs.
* A product mindset: you care whether people use what you build and whether it moves a number.
* The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly without sacrificing code quality.
* Exceptional troubleshooting skills: when something breaks in production at scale, you can diagnose it.
* Ability to keep complex systems simple. Simplicity is a core value.
* Previous remote work experience. You know how to manage your time, communicate proactively, and stay productive without supervision.
* Personal computer with reliable internet access.
* Availability to participate in audio/video meetings and be available on Slack between the hours of 9 AM - 1 PM EST daily.

**Bonus points if you also have:**

* Conversion optimization, marketing tech, analytics, or personalization experience.

* Familiarity with MLOps practices: model versioning, drift monitoring, and experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc).
* Experience with Databricks, AWS SageMaker, or similar ML platforms.
* Familiarity with the WordPress ecosystem, PHP, or SaaS product development. Understanding the end user (small business owners, bloggers, ecommerce operators) is valuable context.
* Experience building internal tools and data platforms that non-technical teams rely on daily.
* Published research, open-source contributions, or technical writing that demonstrates depth of understanding.

  
**Benefits**

**Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here's what we offer.**

* Competitive Salary.

We are accepting applications from individuals with backgrounds in deep learning, model research, and related areas of artificial intelligence to join our AI Research Engineer expert network for future independent project consideration. * Review AI-generated explanations and examples involving deep learning, model architectures, training methods, and model research.
* Evaluate research reasoning, including experimental assumptions, methods, supporting evidence, and conclusions.
* Identify potential problems such as confounded experiments, data leakage, inappropriate baselines, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and unsupported performance claims.
* Assess whether ablation studies and model comparisons isolate the intended variables and support the conclusions presented.
* Provide clear feedback explaining what needs correction and why, including limitations affecting reproducibility or interpretation.
* Suggest appropriate checks that could strengthen an answer without claiming experiments, tests, or results that have not been completed.

Applicants must be **18 or older**. Complete one profile application with your background, education, résumé, and responses to short expertise questions. Select all specialty areas that match your experience.

*An ablation claims a gain but changes the training data and evaluation protocol together. Explain how you would isolate variables, compare baselines, and report reproducibility limits.*
